new_measurement_validity_findings.name: ambiguous-launched-observation-cannot-be-retried
new_measurement_validity_findings.finding: For replay-determinism evidence, a shard that may have launched an observation but fails before a complete durable shard record is available cannot safely be rerun under the same attempt identity. Retrying would create a choose-among-retries channel in the evidence being used to certify replay safety.
new_measurement_validity_findings.rule: Invalidate that capture generation rather than retry any ambiguous attempt. Only a fully completed, durably recorded shard may advance the capture frontier.

new_measurement_validity_findings.name: sharding-preserves-fixed-horizon-only-under-global-precommit
new_measurement_validity_findings.finding: Operational sharding does not change the fixed-horizon statistical contract if and only if all challenge and attempt identities for the full horizon are fixed before the first observation, shard continuation is outcome-independent, the completed union covers the precommitted horizon exactly once, and no ambiguous attempt is retried.
new_measurement_validity_findings.consequence: Partial shards are non-certifying. The fixed-horizon issuance gate must not run until all 1,060 precommitted challenge trials are durably present and globally validated.

new_measurement_validity_findings.name: fresh-attempt-namespace-after-ambiguous-v3-execution
